title: MenuItemsList
description: Structured list of categorized text-only restaurant menu items.

name.description: Name of the dish or item, exactly as found in the text menu (capitalization preserved).

category.description: High-level category this item belongs to.

description.description: Optional description or list of ingredients if present near the item. Otherwise, leave as empty string.

price.description: Optional price, as text (e.g. '12$', '₽350', 'от 15 руб.', '€9.50'). Leave as empty string if not found.

language.description: Detected language of the item name (e.g. 'en', 'ru', 'fr').
